 BT CEO Allison Kirkby says a Starlink deal is “ready to launch” but the company is “cautious on how Starlink might be viewed” after the Ukraine service cutoff   —  Launch will not proceed until ‘noise has died down’ over battlefield service disruptions, says CEO Allison Kirkby
